'''''Imperial Commando: 501st''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published by [[Del Rey]] on [[October 27]], [[2009]]. It serves as a continuation of Traviss' [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]].<ref name="SWBoards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=270737&start=645|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs 3.0|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|check=1}}</ref> The book also contained a preview of ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''.

''501st'' originally was to have a [[Imperial Commando 2|sequel]], but it was cancelled due to Traviss' departure from ''[[Star Wars]]'' writing.
